name: Actuarial Lapse Experience Study (Core Tables)
description: Synthetic actuarial lapse experience study ontology linking cohort lapse variance to business events and illustrative IFRS 17 / EV impacts.
narrative:
## Actuarial lapse experience study

This demo follows 24 months of lapse experience for two plan groups (WP and 20PLP), three policy years and two distribution channels. It compares actual lapse with effective-dated best-estimate assumptions, highlights a September 2024 WP Agency deterioration, and traces the supplied lapse-experience impact into IFRS 17 and EV financial bridges. The source package contains four tables: the policy snapshot, lapse assumptions, monthly experience and financial variance.

### Core measures
- Annualized actual lapse rate = ACTUAL_LAPSES / EXPOSURE * 12.
- Lapse variance (percentage points) = (actual lapse rate - expected lapse rate) * 100; positive is adverse.
- A/E ratio = actual lapse rate / expected lapse rate.
- Financial closing value = opening + expected movement + lapse experience impact + other experience impact + assumption change + economic variance.

### Interpretation and demo limitations
Every monthly expected rate matches the applicable effective-dated assumption. Financial_Variance contains supplied illustrative lapse-impact values for IFRS 17 CSM, Insurance Service Result and EV, in millions. These are not calculated from lapse variance using cash flows or actuarial sensitivities and must not be presented as model-derived valuation results. The four-table package contains no business-event or management-action data, so it supports cohort and financial analysis but not causal attribution or action-effectiveness conclusions. All data is synthetic demo.

Policy_Data is a September 2024 policy snapshot for supporting segmentation; Monthly_Experience is the source for trend and exposure-based lapse rates.

question_rules.template: Explain actual versus expected by month and cohort; state the sign convention and quantify percentage-point and A/E differences.
Rank only cohorts present in Monthly_Experience and retain report month, policy year and channel in the result.

question_rules.patterns: ["where is deterioration concentrated", "lapse differences by cohort"]
question_rules.template: Compare measured lapse variance by plan group, policy year and channel. The retained tables do not contain event or causal-driver data.
Compare experience to the versioned assumption using the effective-date and cohort keys; flag data mismatches.
Use the 24-month Monthly_Experience series and identify the period and cohort grain.
Break down lapse experience by policy year and do not confuse policy duration with calendar year.
Compare September 2024 WP lapse variance across channels using Monthly_Experience, retaining policy year and exposure in the comparison.
Report the supplied CSM lapse impact and bridge metric for the requested plan group and month; distinguish it from a model-derived sensitivity.
Filter Financial_Variance to IFRS17 and Insurance Service Result; report the supplied lapse impact and other bridge movements.
Filter Financial_Variance to EV and EV metric; report the supplied lapse impact and bridge movements.
Compare only like month and plan group; do not add IFRS 17 and EV values together.
Reconcile opening, expected movement, lapse impact, other experience, assumption and economic movement to closing value.
Identify the assumption version and effective dates used for the requested month and cohort.
Treat Policy_Data as a September 2024 snapshot; do not claim it independently supports the 24-month cohort trend.
